evidence: The PEALD method was used to grow AlSi xOy films and a detailed description of the PEALD apparatus may be found in our previous articles. Ar gas was used as the carrier gas and the working pressure was fixed at 3.0 Torr. A subcycle consists of four pulses, Al or Si precursor/purge/reactant gas with plasma/purge and the total exposure time of a subcycle was 6.5 s.
